own_solution.law: Hagen-Poiseuille: dp = 128 eta L Q/(pi d^4), Q = pi d^2 v/4, P = dp Q
assumptions: steady laminar fully developed flow, entrance effects neglected

defect_reasons.other: For the R sentences, 'the pressure drop along the pipe' could be read as along the original 2 m section only (unchanged answer) rather than along the extended pipe; the extended reading the authors certify is the more natural one.

notes: Checked: base dp = 3200 Pa, Q = 2.5133e-6 m^3/s, P = 8.04248 mW. R values: L+q = 5.4, 7.1, 9.3 m give 8.04248*2.7 = 21.7147, *3.55 = 28.5508, *4.65 = 37.3975 mW, all match. C cancellation (p_out drops out of p_in - p_out) correct. Minimal pairs T1EF8/TF825 and TC7C1/T0FF6 share 5.1 m and differ only in attachment/timing. T0EC4 and T4C1C are declared numeral-free twins, which explains the 'short length' wording I noted in pass 1; not a minimal-pair defect. I lowered the ambiguity flag from medium (pass 1) to low because the joined-tubing reading is the natural one and is consistent across both R sentences.
